split_unit: connected components of shared realized physical endpoint conditions

main.description: Leakage-safe 70/15/15 split. Pairs sharing a realized physical endpoint are connected, and left/right mirror counterparts stay in the same split.

left_to_right.description: Train/validation on left turns with endpoint-connected groups; evaluate all right turns.

right_to_left.description: Train/validation on right turns with endpoint-connected groups; evaluate all left turns.
